spec.optimizer: tf.train.adam(lr); other arguments use TensorFlow.js defaults
spec.checkpointRule: minimum validation RMSE; exact ties keep earliest epoch; restore factors

data.hashFormat: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify ordered parsed records
data.splitRule: per user: timestamp asc, movieId asc; floor(0.8*n), floor(0.1*n), remainder test; skip n<5
data.indexing: raw userId/movieId factor rows; reserved row 0 is not a candidate or graph node
